item.title: Investigating Inspector Morse: Fun Facts About Oxford's Savvy Sleuth
item.description: But who is Inspector Morse, really? What makes him an interesting character and how is he so adept at solving crimes? Let’s dive deep into all the ins and outs of DCI Morse to find out.

item.title: Natural Wisdom from Canada's Ageless Gardens' Gardeners
item.description: The world premiere of Season 5 of Ageless Gardens kicks off Monday, May 5 at 9pm ET and airs every Monday through June 2, exclusively on VisionTV. Some of Canada's gardening greats featured in this season share their natural wisdom.

item.title: Making Killers Pay Their Dues: Welcome to The Marlow Murder Club
item.description: Investigate the newest British mystery series earning raves! Join us for our premiere presentation of The Marlow Murder Club, Season 2, Wednesdays at 8pm ET / 5pm PT from Oct. 15 - Nov. 19., 2025.

item.title: All the Hot Watches for VisionTV's Summer of Suspense
item.description: Beat the heat and get your fill of nighttime chills with the best mysteries all summer long! From new favourites to tried and true classics, check out the series we've got lined up for you.

item.title: Preserving the Future: An MZTV Talk with MIT's Peter B Kaufman
item.description: Moses Znaimer, founder and CEO of ZoomerMedia Limited and the MZTV Museum of Television, talks with author and MIT Associate Director of Open Learning Peter B. Kaufman on preservation, archives, truth, and media’s shifting role in the digital age.

item.title: Welcome to a New Season of Suspense on VisionTV
item.description: Calling all armchair detectives and sofa sleuths! Investigate VisionTV’s new mysteries and classic whodunnits all this fall. Discover what's coming up and mark your calendars.

item.title: Uncovering Five Fascinating Facts About Midsomer Murders
item.description: We've recently shaken things up on our sister channel ONETV and we're bringing a fan favourite series over to you here on VisionTV. The long-running British series Midsomer Murders now airs Monday to Friday at 4pm ET / 1pm PT with all 24 seasons to date running back-to-back.

item.title: VisionTV's Great Mystery Destination Contest with Collette is Back
item.description: VisionTV's Great Mystery Destination Contest is back this fall with your chance to win a 10+ day trip for 2, with air, to 1 of 5 amazing world destinations courtesy of Collette.

item.title: 5 Things You May Not Know About Dame Patricia Routledge
item.description: Legions of fans worldwide and all of us at VisionTV were very saddened by the news of British comedy icon Dame Patricia Routledge’s death on October 3, 2025 at the age of 96. To commemorate her passing and to celebrate her long life and full career, here are 5 things you may not have known about Dame Patricia Routledge.
